login_pw=None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name']=='simple_note':
        login_pw=a['password']
        break
print('found_password', login_pw is not None)
print('password_len', len(login_pw) if login_pw else None)
# login
res=apis.simple_note.login(username='ja-solomon@gmail.com', password=login_pw)
print(res)

access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='ja-solomon@gmail.com', password=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()[4]['password'])['access_token']
print('token_acquired', bool(access_token))

# Search for the bucket list note by query
api=apis.simple_note.search_notes
page_index=0
all_results=[]
while True:
    res=api(access_token=access_token, query='Bucket List Simple Note', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    all_results.extend(res)
    if not res or len(res)<20:
        # still break because likely last page; but spec says paginate fully: rely on empty page
        if not res:
            break
        # continue until empty
        if len(res)==0:
            break
    if not res:
        break
    page_index +=1
print('total_results', len(all_results))
print(all_results[:5])
